label: Nitrogen dioxide; LUR estimate for annual average 2010 (ug/m3) - 6th address - at age 60-64 years
meta_rows: Nitrogen dioxide; LUR estimate for annual average 2010 (ug/m3) - 6th address - at age 60-64 years

Annual average concentrations for the year 2010 were modelled for each individual’s address during the 2006-10 follow-up using a Land Use Regression (LUR) model developed as part of the European Study of Cohorts for Air Pollution Effects (ESCAPE) (http://www.escapeproject.eu/), funded under the EU 7th Framework Programme. Air pollution 2010 annual average air pollution concentrations were modelled for all addresses a NSHD participant lived at between 2004 and 2011.
